name: City of Phoenix July 2026 TSMC Arizona Fab Update
known_limitations: The City release relays TSMC's operating, construction, yield, employment, and future-investment claims. It is not an audited production or employment report, a named building-permit or certificate-of-occupancy record, or proof that announced future fabs will be delivered.
source_owner: City of Phoenix Community and Economic Development
automation_notes: Track audited or regulatory production evidence, later fab commissioning, named permits and certificates of occupancy, workforce disclosures, and any correction to the future investment plan. Keep operating milestones separate from announced expansion.
notes: Phase 51C facility record dated July 16, 2026. The City says TSMC's first Arizona fab has been in N4 volume production since late 2024, second-fab construction is complete with production expected in 2027, and TSMC Arizona currently employs more than 3,500 people.
